messages:
Sam (CS): FYI we had intermittent webhook delivery failures for EU onboarding between 2026-04-02 22:10 UTC and 2026-04-03 00:05 UTC affecting ~27 tenants. Putting together a short outbound and CS playbook.

Hannah (CS): Can you drop the tenant list in the shared folder? Ill segment by renewal window and mark high-touch.

Sam (CS): Uploaded list and flagged 7 high-touch accounts. Draft customer note below please shorten if needed.

Sam (CS): ```
Hi {{customer_name}},
We experienced intermittent webhook delivery errors in the EU region on 2026-04-02 between ~22:10 and 00:05 UTC which caused delays and retries for some onboarding events.
What we did: rolled back the proxy change, applied a hotfix, and validated delivery consistency for affected tenants.
What you should know: no customer data was exposed; most events were replayed automatically. If you see missing or duplicate events, reply and well prioritize reconciliation.
Were offering a one-time credit for qualifying accounts; your CSM will reach out.
Regards, Redwood Inference
```

Luca (Eng): Root cause: proxy scaling policy change + malformed upstream headers. Rollback at 2026-04-03T00:02Z. Added header-size validation and extra CI checks. RCA to follow.

Talia (Security): Confirmed no data leakage; retries were idempotent.

Marta (Billing): Proposed credit: 12% of last months invoice for accounts with renewals in 60 days; will process once CS provides CSV.

Sam (CS): Plan: send initial note in next 90m, follow-up with RCA link when ready, schedule priority replays within 48h for high-touch. Add any edits now.

Hannah (CS): Adding office-hours link and short exec summary to the outbound. On it.
